description: Figure 15, titled “Token Ratio (TR),” is a grouped bar chart comparing the Token Ratio performance of three models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents the Token Ratio, scaled from 0 to 1.00, with values explicitly labeled atop each bar. The base model, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0, is consistently normalized to 1.00 across all categories, shown as light gray bars. The other two models, RedWhale (dark blue) and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 (light blue), show lower Token Ratios, indicating greater token efficiency. For example, on PT-EVAL, RedWhale achieves 0.42 and EEVE 0.46; on KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale scores 0.52 and EEVE 0.56. The AVG category shows RedWhale at 0.57 and EEVE at 0.61, both significantly below the base model’s 1.00. The chart visually emphasizes that both adapted models generate fewer tokens than the base model across all tasks, with RedWhale generally outperforming EEVE in token efficiency.
